title: Only until the end of the week to catch Beaches on Broadway but the b...
transcript: Unfortunately, beaches is officially closing at the end of this weekend, so you only have a few more chances to see it on Broadway. However, they are still going on national tour. Now, beaches was always announced as a limited run, originally running through September before going on a national tour. Now the Broadway limited run has been cut short, but that national tour is still happening. My heart goes out to the cast and crew over at beaches. I don't think this was an easy run. I especially with how empty those theatres are, that's always hard as a performer to perform to. I don't think anybody is surprised to see this closing announcement coming. However, I do think this is a musical that is going to play much better out on tour and definitely being licensed at regional and community theatres. There are really special moments, especially in the second act of this production. It just is sort of outweighed by the fact that you're seeing this on a Broadway stage and expect more design wise, quality wise. But I do think that there's stuff to enjoy in this musical and I do think that it's going to be able to find its audience out on the road. But all my love to this cast, cause they were incredible.
reasoning: Creator acknowledges special moments and praises the cast, but says the production doesn't meet Broadway design/quality expectations and will play better on tour/regionally. This is a lukewarm mixed take rather than a recommendation.
